suffix.close: One clear subject, framed close and large: it fills most of the picture and reaches into every quarter of it, so any quarter of the picture shows a recognisable part of it. A calm, simple background in strong contrast with the subject, with only gentle texture. Strong shapes and clear, bold colours. No text, letters, numbers, logos, brand names, signature, watermark, border or frame.
suffix.photo: Deep depth of field: everything sharp from foreground to background. Rich, fine detail and texture spread evenly over the whole frame, so any small square cut from it still shows recognisable detail; no large plain, empty or blurred areas, and only a modest amount of sky. Keep the main subjects away from the outer edges of the frame. A real professional photograph with true natural colours. No text, letters, writing, logos, watermark, border, frame or vignette.
suffix.painting: The painting fills the entire image edge to edge: no frame, no border, no visible canvas or paper edge, no signature, no text or writing. Rich detail spread evenly across the whole picture, so any small square cut from it still shows recognisable detail; no large plain or empty areas. Keep the main subjects away from the outer edges.

pictures.title: Harbour at Dusk
pictures.prompt: An impressionist oil painting of a Mediterranean harbour town at sunset. Pastel houses and a tall stone bell tower line the waterfront across the middle of the picture; small fishing boats and sailboats are moored in the calm water across the foreground; the setting sun sits low over distant hills, laying long golden reflections across the rippled water. Thick visible brush strokes and canvas texture.

pictures.title: Dunes at Sundown
pictures.prompt: A photorealistic wide panoramic photograph of a Sahara desert camp at sunset: a camel caravan with riders in robes crossing the foreground along a dune ridge, their long shadows on rippled sand; dry shrubs, rocks and footprints; a palm oasis with low tents, rugs and a glowing lantern in the middle distance; layered dune crests catching orange light beside deep violet shadows; a hazy peach and coral sky with a low sun and wispy clouds near the horizon.

pictures.title: Poppies at Sunset

pictures.title: Oranges by Candlelight
pictures.prompt: A Dutch Golden Age style oil still life lit by candlelight: a brass candlestick with a lit candle, a pewter plate of oranges and apricots, one orange half-peeled with its peel curling over the table edge, a copper jug, a loaf of bread, a glass of amber wine, walnuts and a rumpled peach-coloured cloth on a wooden table. Behind them, a warm plastered wall and an open window showing an orange sunset sky over rooftops, so the background is full of detail rather than dark. Fine glazed brushwork.

pictures.title: Blossom Lane

Loose wet-in-wet washes, granulating pigment, visible paper grain and crisp painted edges.

pictures.title: Strawberry Layer Cake
